'''Thiin''' (Thiinma) is a nearly extinct [[Australian Aboriginal languages|Australian Aboriginal language]] of the [[Mantharta language|Mantharta]] group, spoken in [[Western Australia]]. {{as of|2025}}, only one person, Peter Salmon, can speak it.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2021-01-15 |title=Peter Salmon is the only known speaker of his language — he wants to change that before it's too late |url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-01-15/peter-salmon-last-indigenous-thiinma-language-speaker/12962750 |access-date=2026-03-12 |work=ABC News |language=en-AU}}</ref>
